generatingProcess.formula: y = C + A*sin(FREQ*x) + B*x + noise, noise ~ Normal(0, NOISE_SD)
generatingProcess.seedNote: Fixed before generation; no seed search (unlike the Exercise 6 greedy-split activity).

syntheticDataNote: This dataset is simulated: one continuous predictor and a noisy, smooth nonlinear target, generated from a fixed formula and seed. It is used to walk through squared-error gradient boosting one shallow tree at a time -- these are not ABIDE observations.
